summary: Frontend-only verification of the new measurement-based Wordmark fix (src/ui.tsx). At viewports 360x780, 390x844, and 430x932: testID='app-logo' renders with opacity=1 (measurement completed, not stuck at 0), AFTER and PARTY each on a single line, pink dot visible to the right of PARTY, and the PARTY-row width equals the target fillWidth = round((viewport-48)*0.8) within 0.3px (well under the ±10px tolerance). Zero horizontal overflow at every tested viewport (body.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth). Resize from 390→360 re-measures correctly (party row 273.7→249.7, matching new expected 250). Login with test@afterparty.app / Test1234! lands on the feed with 'London' visible and the small feed-header Wordmark (no fillWidth prop) renders normally at its default size. No console errors; only the pre-existing benign react-native-web 'textShadow*' deprecation warnings.
action_items: Optional (non-blocking, carried over from iteration_2): react-native-web warns 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated — use the new 'textShadow' shorthand. Only noise, no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: Wordmark now correctly uses onLayout on the PARTY-row View to measure actual rendered width at a PROBE=40 font size, then derives scale = fillWidth/w. Observed outputs match expected fillWidth within <0.5px across all three viewports — tighter than the previous fixed-ratio approach.

useEffect([fillWidth]) resetting scale to null correctly re-triggers remeasurement on viewport resize; verified by shrinking 390→360 and observing partyRow width drop from 273.7 to 249.7 while opacity stays at 1 after the brief probe.

Opacity gate (0 until first measurement, then 1) prevents the flash of the oversized probe layout. On web the gate reliably reaches 1 before user perception; no stuck-at-0 observed on reload or resize.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measurement-based Wordmark verified at 360/390/430 viewports and on live resize. PARTY-row width matches fillWidth=(viewport-48)*0.8 within 0.3px, no body overflow, opacity reaches 1, pink dot renders. Login flow unaffected; feed-header Wordmark (no fillWidth) renders at default size. Only non-blocking react-native-web textShadow deprecation warnings in console.
